resources.name: Core Out Of Memory Alert Items

strings: The disk rejected this name. Check its length and remove unsupported characters.
The item could not be found.
This operation is not available for this item.
There is not enough memory to complete the operation.
The item is in use. Try again after closing it.
The disk could not be read or written.
The disk is locked. Choose another disk.
An item with this name already exists.
The item is locked or protected.
The disk is full. Choose another disk.
The disk could not be restored after an error. Remount it before saving again.
The operation could not be completed.
Finder stopped. You can inspect the report and restart Finder.
The application stopped. You can inspect or copy the complete report.
Not enough memory to restart Finder. Close another application and try again.
Earlier diagnostic retained; the latest capture failed.
Finder cannot safely restart. Copy the report, then restart System.
Restart unavailable: the power device could not be selected.
Close other applications, then try Restart System again.
Storage is not ready. Finish file operations, then retry.
The power device refused System restart. The report is retained.
System restart failed. The report is retained.
The application returned an error. You can inspect or copy the report.
An invalid memory access stopped the application. Inspect or copy the report.
A processor exception stopped the application. Inspect or copy the report.
